test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Parents expect / children to / comply by / their wishes.
solution:
The correct answer is **'comply by'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The erroneous part of the sentence is **comply by. **
